sources.title: Learn about restricted settings - Android Help
sources.snippet: When you enable restricted settings, you allow apps to get access to sensitive info that could put your personal data at risk.

sources.title: Change app permissions on your Android phone
sources.snippet: On your device, open the Settings app. Tap Apps. Tap the app you want to change. Then, choose your app. Tap Permissions. Learn about restricted settings
